elements_not_encoded.text: If shock/SBP < 80, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV over 30 minutes, repeat until systolic BP > 80. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Fluid management; no manage tasks in this pass.

elements_not_encoded.text: If meningococcal disease likely: give ceftriaxone3 2g IM. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site.
Notify4 as suspected meningococcal disease. If possible, isolate patient, and give surgical mask to prevent spread.
Prevent disease in close household contacts:
If contact < 6 years old, give ceftriaxone3 125mg IM as a single dose (dissolve ceftriaxone 250mg in 0.9mL lidocaine 1% without adrenaline (epinephrine); discar
If contact 6-12 years old, give ciprofloxacin 250mg as a single dose.
If contact ≥12 years, give ciprofloxacin 500mg as a single dose. If pregnant, give instead ceftriaxone3 250mg IM (dissolve ceftriaxone 250mg in 0.9mL lidocaine
If serious drug reaction likely: stop all medication. If peeling or raw skin, also manage as for burns before referral 31.
